facts.raw_span: severe bilateral pneumonia
recent close contact with a fatal case
No relevant medical history was reported
blurred vision and redness in her right eye
temporary (8-day) pain when mobilizing the globe
Best-corrected visual acuity was +2 logMAR (hand movement) OD
Relative afferent pupil defect
Central scotoma
Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2
Negative CSF SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR
Cranial MRI with fine optic nerve cuts (normal results)
Fluorescein Angiography (Day 30): Mild leakage associated with inferior peripapillary hemorrhage

concepts.why: The patient has severe bilateral pneumonia and a positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, indicating a COVID-19 infection.
The patient has blurred vision, redness in the right eye, and a relative afferent pupil defect, indicating optic neuritis.
The patient has fluorescein leakage from retinal venules, indicating retinal vasculitis.
The patient has optic nerve atrophy and a positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, indicating SARS-CoV-2-associated optic neuropathy.
The patient has retinal vessel narrowing and a positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, indicating viral retinitis.
The patient has neurological symptoms, including blurred vision, and a positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, indicating Neuro-COVID-19.
The patient has optic neuritis and a positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, indicating post-infectious optic neuritis.
The patient has uveitis and a positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, indicating COVID-19-associated uveitis.
The negative CSF SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR finding suggests that the optic neuritis may not be directly caused by SARS-CoV-2, and Multiple Sclerosis is a known cause of optic neuritis.

rationales.F01: Severe bilateral pneumonia is a common symptom of COVID-19.
rationales.F04: Blurred vision and redness in one eye are symptoms of optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis.
rationales.F06: Best-corrected visual acuity of +2 logMAR is a significant visual impairment.
rationales.F09: Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 confirms COVID-19 infection.
rationales.F12: Fluorescein Angiography showing mild leakage associated with inferior peripapillary hemorrhage is consistent with optic neuritis and retinal vasculitis.
